searchText: Hey all, small question regarding DUPN / SWAPN. Why do we have DUP[1] for instance? I can also use the "normal" DUP1 for this (this also saves me an deployment byte). Compilers will likely optimize this out. Why don't we start at DUPN[17] ? (Same for SWAPN)
